description: A review-authority row is green when merge admission has a blocking machine-verifiable review status or durable evidence from PR Code Review plus a trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci gate packet, proves reviewer identity is distinct from the author, and binds the reviewed PR title/body evidence.

rows.evidence_path: PR ## Code Review section + trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci review-admission gate packet + PR reviews API readback
rows.requirement: Protected branch merge admission requires a pre-merge review authority, not only the oya-ci-required context, and that authority must bind the reviewed PR title/body evidence.
